newsitem.title: GERMANY: OLYMPICS-GERMANY'S RUHR REGION TO BID FOR 2008 GAMES.
newsitem.headline: OLYMPICS-GERMANY'S RUHR REGION TO BID FOR 2008 GAMES.

text.p: Germany's Ruhr region, the densely populated coal-and-steel territory in the far west of the country, on Tuesday announced that it planned to bid to host the 2008 Summer Olympic Games.

The region will get together with nearby Duesseldorf to stage the bid, assuming that the 2004 Games are as expected awarded to a country in Africa, Guenter Samtlebe, head of the "Olympia im Ruhrgebiet" committee, told a news conference.

The region is in effect a vast conglomeration including cities such as Essen, Bochum, Dortmund and Duisburg. A decision on which city will spearhead the bid, which has received the support of the German Olympic Committee, is to be made later.
The Ruhr area was an early candidate for the 2000 Games but was persuaded to drop its bid in favour of newly-reunited Berlin. The 2000 Games were eventually awarded to Sydney.
